direction: Wide still from the hill. Llandough fields and hedges run down to the Ely, with the marshes and the estuary far off under a grey sky. The view is inland, looking down. Slow lateral drift across the field pattern the surveyors had recently mapped. Ambience: skylark, wind. About 14 seconds.
